Java has two different WHILE loops: The regular WHILE loop and the ENHANCED FOR loop, what we know in Python as a FOR loop is the equivalent of an ENHANCED FOR loop in Java.

Python and Java, WHILE loops and DO-WHILE loops differ on when their condition is checked, WHILE loops check their condition after finishing an iteration, DO-WHILE loops check their condition before starting an iteration, this means that WHILE loops will always execute at least once, while DO-WHILE loops may not execute at all.
